title: Moving & Storage in Costa Mesa | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Lease gap, remodel or a move out of state? Moving and storage in Costa Mesa, CA, from SOS Moving: pickup, a climate-controlled hold and the return.
heroSubtitle: One crew empties the rooms, holds everything in a climate-controlled facility and brings it back on the date you name.

faq.question: Where do my things actually go once the truck pulls away?
faq.answer: Straight to our monitored, climate-controlled facility, where temperature and humidity are held steady all year. Nothing is dropped in a container on your street, and every piece stays on the inventory written at pickup until you set a return date.

faq.question: Can a moving truck stand on my street while the crew loads?
faq.answer: City code keeps commercial vehicles off streets that are not designated truck routes, with an exception for temporary parking while a delivery or a service is being performed, which is what a pickup is. We still ask at booking where the truck can stand, because even on a truck route nothing may stand longer than three hours or park between 2 a.m. and 6 a.m.

faq.question: What do the pickup and the return cost?
faq.answer: Both legs are hourly. Monday through Thursday two movers with a truck are $119 in cash or $129 by card; Friday through Sunday the same pair is $135 or $145, and larger crews are listed above with the gas, deposit and certificate fees. The storage term is priced from your inventory and arrives with the estimate.

faq.question: We are building an ADU. How long can the furniture stay?
faq.answer: As long as the build takes. Long-term storage starts at a month and extends without a penalty, so a permit delay or a longer legalization under the Safe ADU program changes the length of the term and nothing else. You call when the rooms are ready.

faq.question: Do you store for people who are not moving house at all?
faq.answer: Yes. A booking can be storage alone, and plenty of bookings across Costa Mesa are a pickup now and a return to the same address after a remodel, a repair or an inspection. No change of address is required anywhere in the process.

faq.question: How much notice does the return trip need?
faq.answer: A few days is comfortable, since the crew pulls your inventory from the facility before the truck sets out. Pickups can sometimes happen the same day when a crew is open, so call 909-443-0004 in the morning and we will check the board.
